result.title: Code Insights DB Reporting Agent Skill

answers.answer: Both: Install globally (~/.gemini/skills/code-insights-reports) and copy to local repo (.agents/skills/code-insights-reports)

answers.customAnswer: project development timelines/adrs with graph trace like analysis
answers.answer:
Session Reflection: Cross-session summaries, key decisions, architectural learnings, and weekly/monthly digests
Cost & Token Economics: Model token consumption, prompt caching efficiency, cost per project, and burn rate
Friction & Failure Loops: Course corrections, rage loops, abandoned sessions, and friction taxonomy
Prompt Quality: SFL breakdown (Ideational/Interpersonal/Textual), score trends, and prompt optimization suggestions
Tool Comparison: Comparing session volume, efficiency, and satisfaction across Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, Mistral, Hermes, etc.
Ad-Hoc SQL Querying: Answering open-ended natural language questions by synthesizing safe SQLite queries
project development timelines/adrs with graph trace like analysis
Hybrid: sqlite3 CLI for ad-hoc queries + dedicated helper script(s) in skill for complex multi-table aggregations

Executive Markdown Briefs: Concise conversational summaries with key takeaways and actionable recommendations
Tabular Data: Formatted ASCII/Markdown tables with rankings, percentiles, and counts
Saved Artifact Reports: Writing detailed reports to disk (e.g. reports/ or brain artifacts) for review

Strict Read-Only: Enforce URI mode=ro or PRAGMA query_only=ON so the agent cannot mutate data
Busy Timeout: Set 5000ms busy_timeout so reads don't fail when the sync hook or worker is writing
Schema Drift Check: Verify schema version (current v18) or table existence before complex joins
